title: SECAC MONTHLY MEETING - OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY AND MARYLAND VOLUNTEERS LAWYER PROJECT
description: SECAC MONTHLY MEETING - OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY AND MARYLAND VOLUNTEERS LAWYER PROJECT Thursday, November 5, 2026 6:30-8:30 p.m. Virtual Event We invite you to join us for an informative evening…
description_full: SECAC MONTHLY MEETING - OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY AND MARYLAND VOLUNTEERS LAWYER PROJECT Thursday, November 5, 2026 6:30-8:30 p.m. Virtual Event We invite you to join us for an informative evening featuring two guest speakers who will share valuable information and resources to support our special education community. Jillianne J. Trotter – Maryland Volunteer Lawyers Service (MVLS) Learn about the Special Education Project and the resources available to help families navigate the special education process. Greg Santucci – Occupational Therapy Join us for a discussion on occupational therapy, sensory needs, and practical strategies to support students at home and in school. Visit registration page . The Special Education Citizens Advisory Committee (SECAC) works with the school system to support the needs of students with disabilities in Howard County . Anyone involved in special education in the county is invited to participate in our meetings including parents/caregivers, students, educators, community partners, service providers and school administrators. For more information contact SECACChair@gmail.com or visit www.howardcountysecac.com . Free

description_full: FAMILY FUN DAY Saturday, November 7, 2026 drop in anytime between 10:00 a.m.-12:00 p.m. Running Brook Elementary School 5215 W. Running Brook Rd. Columbia, MD The event will be held in the school cafeteria, which is on the left side of the building. Come enjoy a morning of games, activities and movement in a safe and nurturing environment for children with a developmental delay or disability, up to the age of five. Staff from Early Intervention Services will be on hand to support you and your child. This event is for families who have children up to the age of five with an IEP or IFSP. Siblings are welcome. Contact FSRC@hcpss.org or EISFamily@hcpss.org with questions. The event will be cancelled if HCPSS has an inclement weather closure. This event is sponsored by HCPSS and aligns with the question about parents being connected with other families for mutual support in the MDSE survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free
